    Measurement-algebra lifting via free-product permanence (single-citation wiring) #

    The measurement algebra B ≅ ∗ⁿ (Fin m → ℂ) inherits the *-hom approximate u.c.p. lifting property (HasStarHomApproxUCPLift) from its finite-dimensional factors — the free-product permanence that Boca's u.c.p. free-product extension theorem proves. Node 3 (finPiComplex_hasStarHomApproxUCPLift, kernel-trio) supplies the factor lifting; feeding it into permanence gives the measurement-algebra lifting as a one-liner. BocaFreeProductPermanenceProof constructs that permanence for the Type-0 capstone.

    source
    def ZFib.CEP.BocaFreeProductPermanence {X : Type} [Fintype X] {m : ℕ} {B : Type u} [CStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B] (_S : MeasurementAlgebraStructure X m B) :
    Prop

    Full-free-product approximate u.c.p. lifting permanence (the deep node-4 gate). The full unital C*-free product B = ∗ₓ (Fin m → ℂ) over ℂ1 (structured by S) inherits HasStarHomApproxUCPLift from its finite-dim factors. This is a DERIVED permanence — NOT the bare Boca/Davidson-Kakariadis u.c.p. free-product extension theorem (which alone is insufficient: a generic u.c.p. map is non-multiplicative on words, so permanence needs the reduced-word formula + finite-word density + a smaller factor tolerance δ). Source: Boca 2015 (arXiv:1508.03123) Prop. 11 / Cor. 12 (LLP permanence for full free products via the Boca free-product u.c.p. map); Ozawa (arXiv:math/0306067) Prop. 3.21 (LLP stable under full free product). The downstream BocaFreeProductPermanenceProof supplies the Mathlib-absent dilation, centered-word formula, closed-range descent, and finite-word estimate. NOTE: the antecedent HasStarHomApproxUCPLift (Fin m → ℂ) is kernel-proved (finPiComplex_hasStarHomApproxUCPLift).
